mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_invocation ( invocation_id, enterprise_id, user_id, device_id, client_instance_id, client_request_id, request_id, request_digest, model_id, model_revision, configuration_revision, runtime_registry_generation, admission_type, admission_digest, provider_request_deadline_at, provider_stream_idle_timeout_millis, status, status_revision, last_durable_event_sequence, durable_event_stream_digest, dispatch_decision, cancel_requested_at, cancel_reason, timeout_intent_at, usage_json, finish_reason, safe_error_code, safe_summary, created_at, started_at, ended_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{invocationId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{clientInstanceId}, #{clientRequestId}, #{requestId}, #{requestDigest}, #{modelId}, #{modelRevision}, #{configurationRevision}, #{runtimeRegistryGeneration}, #{admissionType}, #{admissionDigest}, #{providerRequestDeadlineAt}, #{providerStreamIdleTimeoutMillis}, #{status}, #{statusRevision}, #{lastDurableEventSequence}, #{durableEventStreamDigest}, #{dispatchDecision}, #{cancelRequestedAt}, #{cancelReason}, #{timeoutIntentAt}, #{usageJson}, #{finishReason}, #{safeErrorCode}, #{safeSummary}, #{createdAt}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (enterprise_id, user_id, device_id, client_instance_id, client_request_id) DO NOTHING
